regions.full_page: Wonderful !! Lives Without Eating. Robert E. Morissey 7, of 1409 cavalry Ave. (Detroit) burned by swallowing potash when 52 - Sept. 6th 1923 - has never swallowed since, except once when thought dy- ing he swallowed Holy Viaticum - his First Communion. This was after one of the 30 operations he has had in a year and 6 months. Same R. E. M. nourishes himself now by masticating it first and then emitting it through a tube into the front of abdomen. . .... Today at Monastery seems "picture of health" and innocently mis- chievous enough too - Hopes to be a priest some day. Please God, we'll hope with him.

regions.full_page: Reconciliation! Is It Hopeless? - No. Melvin Wood 39, Royal Oak, divorced from Wife and 5 children for near a year is enrolled To- day in S.M. A. by brokenhearted Wife - She fears for his soul and loss of family property. Has tried in vain to come to some kind of understanding. We'll thank God now for the speedy reconcilia- tion we hope for. Praised be God!
